verdict.rationale: Pulumi's real-language SDKs let users loop/iterate to define and manage many resources at once, and the Automation API explicitly exposes the full IaC engine programmatically to create/update/destroy infrastructure dynamically across many stacks (pulumi-docs-2, pulumi-docs-33, pulumi-docs-34, pulumi-gh-4). The MCP server and Neo further let AI agents query and act across all cloud resources/stacks in bulk (pulumi-docs-7, pulumi-docs-26, pulumi-docs-20), and a community report confirms real-world use of Automation API for infrastructure migrations at scale (pulumi-comm-20). Missing for 10: concrete documented examples/benchmarks of large-scale bulk operations (e.g., batch import across hundreds of resources) and independent hands-on validation of performance/reliability at scale.
